name: Free Pass
source:
A youthful-looking, happily married Asian wife, Yoon Ni Ko, who was born & raised in a culturally strict country, was convinced to risk her marriage after being a faithful wife for many years. Is it wrong to give an Asian strict woman a Free Pass?? Or will there be some improvement in her long-term marriage?

[From [url=https://after-choices.itch.io/freepass]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Yoon Ni Ko是一位外貌年轻、婚姻幸福的亚洲人妻，在一个文化风气保守的国家出生长大。多年来，她始终忠于丈夫，却在他人的劝说下，决定让自己的婚姻冒一次险。给这样一位严守规矩的亚洲女性一次自由放纵的机会，究竟是错？还是反而能为她多年的婚姻带来一些改善？

[摘自[url=https://after-choices.itch.io/freepass]itch.io[/url]]
